subject: hoverPickup
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: militarized pickup converted to hover thrusters.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.
reasoning:
I'm planning a static model of a hovering pickup truck, roughly 5.4m long and 2m wide, built from boxes and cylinders with thrusters in place of wheels, keeping it low to the ground at around 0.25 studs of hover height.

I'm working out the geometry so the hover pods touch y=0 at their nozzles while the chassis sits higher, laying out cab, hood, and bed sections along the length and placing glowing thruster rings at each corner pod.

Adding a militarized turret, armor plates, glowing headlights, neon side strips, decals, bull bar, and rear thruster pods, aiming for a mirrored layout with roughly 150 parts total.

Writing helper functions...

Positioning pods outward with slight fender flare, and settling on a cyberpunk palette of gunmetal body, dark trim plates, and neon cyan/magenta accent colors.

Now figuring out the windshield geometry -- tilting it backward by rotating about the X-axis with a negative angle so the top leans toward -z, placing it just forward of the cab front.

Positioning the cab box, side window panels, and roof slab, then sizing the hood box to sit forward and slightly below the cab.

Now I'm laying out the front bumper, bull bar, glowing headlights, and neon grille, then shaping the bed with floor, side walls, tailgate, and front wall dimensions, before placing the turret pedestal and gun body in the bed.

I'm adding the gun barrel, protective shield plate, side ammo box, and missile pods with tube arrays, then positioning the twin rear thruster cylinders with glowing end discs, and finally planning the cyan and magenta neon strip placement along the body and skirt.

Writing decal and detail code...
